en: Black‑and‑white view over a small European town nestled in wooded hills. In the foreground stands a large three‑storey rectangular building with ornate arched windows and a flat, balustraded roof, likely a civic or spa building. Behind and above it on a hill is a tall church with a tower and spire, surrounded by dense trees. Several smaller houses with steep tiled roofs line a curving road at the base of the hill. The setting appears tranquil and semi‑rural, typical of an early 20th‑century spa or resort town.
